projectBackground.name: Merchant Dashboard Rebuild
projectBackground.context: Merchants report the dashboard is unusable on phones and screen readers cannot read the forms.

manager.name: Kasia Wrona
manager.note: Half our users are on phones. If it only works on your laptop, it doesn't work.

assignment.title: Make the dashboard work for everyone
assignment.brief: Diagnose viewport, accessibility and performance issues and write a bug report.

documents.name: Accessibility Audit
documents.note: Inputs without labels, images without alt text, focus not visible.

documents.name: Performance Trace
documents.note: Hero image 1.2 MB on a 4 Mbps connection.

tasks.title: Mobile Basics
tasks.prompt: The page looks zoomed-out on phones. Which tag is missing?
tasks.reasoning: Without the viewport meta the browser renders at desktop width and scales down.
tasks.mistake: Fixing font size alone doesn't solve layout scaling.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Download Time
tasks.prompt: A 1.2 MB image downloads on a 4 Mbps connection. About how many seconds (1 byte = 8 bits; 1.2 MB = 9.6 Mb)?
tasks.reasoning: Convert megabytes to megabits before dividing by the bandwidth.
tasks.mistake: Forgetting the factor of 8 underestimates time by 8x.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Images
tasks.prompt: Which is the right treatment for a meaningful product image?
tasks.reasoning: Alt text lets screen readers convey meaning; decorative images use empty alt.
tasks.mistake: Generic alt text gives no information.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Accessibility Fixes
options: Keep a visible keyboard focus style
Don't rely on colour alone to convey errors
Associate a label with every input
tasks.reasoning: Labels, focus and non-colour cues are core requirements.
tasks.mistake: Removing focus outlines locks out keyboard users.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Layout Shift
tasks.prompt: Content jumps as images load. What reduces it?
options: Set image width and height or aspect-ratio
tasks.mistake: Ignoring it hurts usability and metrics.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Bug Report
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence bug report for the mobile layout issue.
tasks.modelAnswer: On phones under 400 px the dashboard overflows horizontally because the grid has fixed three columns and there is no viewport meta. Expected: single-column layout with readable text. Steps: open the dashboard on a 390 px viewport. I propose adding the viewport meta, switching to a responsive grid with a media query and compressing the hero image from 1.2 MB. Accessibility fixes for labels will follow in a separate change.
tasks.reasoning: A good bug report has context, expected result, steps and a proposal.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Form Nobody Could Use
caseStudy.background: A checkout form lacked labels; screen-reader users could not complete purchases. A complaint triggered a legal review and a rebuild.
caseStudy.challenges: Accessibility was not part of the definition of done.
caseStudy.constraints: No automated or manual audit existed.
questions: Why does missing labels block users?
How could this be caught earlier?
caseStudy.solution: Forge added accessibility checks to the definition of done and CI.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Accessibility is part of quality, not an extra.
